subject: general
question: The mean of 11, 10, 12, 13, 15, x and 17, is 15. The value of x is:
solution:
Given:

The mean of 11, 10, 12, 13, 15, x and 17, is 15

Concept used:

Total = Mean × Number of entities

Calculation:

(10 + 11 + 12 + 13 + 15 + 17 + x) = 15 × 7

⇒ x = 27

**∴ The value of x is 27.**
